# What is a member worth, and what does churn cost you?

> Free calculator for boutique gym, yoga, pilates and CrossFit owners: member lifetime value, cost to win a member, payback months, where your member count settles, break-even members and what one point of churn is worth. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
